summary: Pearl Dental has awards, an Invisalign Platinum badge and two lead forms. Leftover text and dead menu links make the page look unfinished right where a patient decides to book.

findings.problem: Old menu labels such as Gum disease treatment-old and Tooth Filling-old are visible in the mobile menu, and the text Thank you for contacting Pearl Dental Clinic appears outside any form.
findings.cost: Leftover labels and messages on a mobile page look unfinished to a patient who is about to trust you with treatment.
findings.fix: A clean menu and hidden confirmation messages that show only after a form is sent.

findings.problem: Our Team, Patient Guide and Media in the main menu link to #. Dental tourism and veneers each link to two different URLs, and the 800 PEARLS phone link has no country code.
findings.cost: Dead links lose visitors and a phone link that does not dial from abroad loses your dental tourism patients.
findings.fix: Working menu links and a phone link that dials from anywhere.

findings.problem: Dr. Divya Nair is titled Peridontist instead of Periodontist, and reviews name Dr. Mahmood and Dr. Salah, who are not in Our Doctors.
findings.cost: A typo in a specialist title and unlisted doctors in reviews raise doubts about who will treat the patient.
findings.fix: Proofread titles and a team list that matches your reviews.

findings.problem: Three testimonials are cut off with [...] and carry no stars or dates. No before and after cases or prices appear, though affordable pricing is claimed.
findings.cost: Patients choose on visible results and price. Cut off reviews and a missing price make them compare other clinics.
findings.fix: Full, dated reviews, captioned before and after cases and starting prices.

redesign: A clean, proof first homepage with full reviews, awards and captioned results beside every booking button.
One simple booking form with WhatsApp, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like Invisalign Dubai and dental implants Business Bay.
